faq.title: Everything you need to know about AssetHub

items.q: What sets AssetHub apart from traditional CMMS software?
items.a: Unlike rigid legacy software, AssetHub lets you model any physical asset with dynamic schemas, customizable state machines, and multi-level hierarchies. It also provides native multi-tenancy for service providers managing multiple client portals.

items.q: How does tenant isolation work in the multi-tenant architecture?
items.a: Each client logs in via their dedicated subdomain (e.g., client.yourdomain.app). Sessions, asset registries, audit logs, and permissions are strictly isolated per tenant, with optional cross-tenant dispatching roles.

items.q: Can field technicians use the platform on mobile without app store downloads?
items.a: Yes, our web client is completely mobile-responsive and optimized for touch devices. Field workers can access work orders, checklists, and incident forms right from mobile browsers.

items.q: Can we export and integrate asset and incident data?
items.a: Absolutely. AssetHub provides secure REST APIs and structured export capabilities to sync with your existing ERPs, analytical warehouses, or financial reporting tools.
